statePersistence: Business data in active tab only; feedback localStorage best-effort and downloadable export. Reload restores synthetic seed.
network: No external requests; no Facebook, AI API, real Push, Telegram, carriers or payments.
architecture: Portable JavaScript simulation, NOT production React/Nest/Prisma source. Do not copy app.js into product architecture.

functionalFlows.name: Sales → phone → preparation → delivery → COD
functionalFlows.details: Create synthetic confirmed order; event dedupe; claim; pick checklist; pack; handover decreases stock without revenue; delivery records revenue/COGS/COD receivable; settlement nets delivery fee exactly.

functionalFlows.name: Low stock → approval → PO → receipt → AP
functionalFlows.details: Reorder subtracts pending orders; owner approves immutable intent; simulated send/confirmation; partial receipts update stock+AP with balanced journals. No money transfer.

functionalFlows.name: Role, pause, offline and feedback
functionalFlows.details: UI role guards/offline write guards, sales pause for simulated auto-order, per-shop state and route-context feedback export.
